title: 第三章 这家伙是来真的？
content_zh:
事实证明，是自己误会了。
盲盒开出来的奖励，确实有“五个”。
系统并没有干“吞装备”这种缺德事儿，也的确不存在“谢谢惠顾”这种说法。
只不过，第五个盲盒开出来的奖品，被另外四个奖品给压住了……
此刻摆在楚光面前的，是一块真空包装、净含量100g的压缩饼干，和三根净含量25g的棒棒糖——分别是苹果、香蕉、芒果口味。
以及，一张纸条。
压缩饼干的包装完好，没有鼓包，虽然保质期和生产日期是个迷，但应该吃不死人。
这玩意儿是个好东西。
配料表上标注的热量有500大卡，无论是干吃还是丢锅里煮成糊糊，都能填饱肚子。
至于棒棒糖，热量虽然不低，但不能提供饱腹感。
不过，对于穷到快要啃树皮的楚光而言，已经很不错了。
话说这系统也太特么抠门儿了，是深怕他吃的太饱还是怎么滴，就拿这点东西打发他。
站在出货口旁边的楚光，将食物塞进了随身携带的背包，接着捡起了被传送带送出来的纸条，展开看了一眼。
上面写着一些字，用的是这边世界的语言。
【……这个世界上还有什么生物比玩家更适合当韭菜？
他们不但有着旺盛的好奇心，而且永远充满热情，面对困难迎难而上，不会绝望于眼前的窘境。当然，最最最关键的是，他们甚至还能站在运营商的角度考虑问题，帮着运营商一起收割自己！
将这套装置包装成游戏的我简直是天才！
——404号避难所初代管理者；（请这张纸条放在第五个初级盲盒中，这是我留给继任者的彩蛋！）】
楚光：“……”
老实说，他非但没有感到一丁点儿收获彩蛋的惊喜，甚至有点儿无语。

不过……
装置是什么意思？
“小柒。”
“怎么了，主人。”
“你认识初代管理者吗？”
“不认识，当您进入避难所时，我的主程序才被激活。根据避难所数据库中的资料记载，上一任管理者将操作权限移交，已经是一个多世纪前的事情了。”
楚光继续问道。
“具体是哪一年？”
小柒回答。
“2157年1月1日。”
2129年战争结束，人类文明进入废土纪元，2157年也就是废土纪元的第28年。
距离现在……
183年！
楚光从小对数字就很敏感，尤其是这种关键的信息，他基本是
“也就是说，183年前的初代管理者，发明了这套能够将平行世界的意识体，投射到克隆人身上的装置，并将其包装成游戏，但出于某些原因一直没有使用对吗？”
也许是因为核冬天。
也或者是别的原因，导致避难所没有满足启动条件。
无论如何，一百年前的人，怎么想都应该已经去世了。
小柒说道。
“应该是吧。”

“他叫什么名字？那个初代管理者。”
楚光对他的身份忽然有些好奇。
想出那些恶趣味设定的人不一定是天才，但能够在文明衰退之后，凭一己之力发明出如此牛逼黑科技的人，天才这个词都已经不足以用来形容他了。
将平行世界的意识体投射到本位面，并且装进作为容器的克隆体。
楚光想象不到，这究竟是如何做到的。
超出认知的技术，对于他来说和魔法没什么区别。
“我也不知道，已知的数据库中并没有关于他的详细资料，会不会是被删掉了？”
“算了……问你等于白问。”
楚光略微失望，却并没有气馁。
目前避难所只解锁到了B1层。
随着任务的不断推进，埋藏在这座避难所中的秘密，总有一天会在他面前展现出全貌。
将纸条随手塞进了电脑桌的抽屉，楚光紧了紧身上的背包。
注意到他的动作，蹲在墙角的小柒问道。
“主人，您要走了吗？”
那没有高低起伏的声音，听着怪可怜的。
“嗯，玩家三天后才会登陆，我在这里继续守着也没有任何意义，不如回去准备一下。”
这破地方说是避难所，却连吃的喝的都没有。
楚光身上现在就剩半块巴掌大的饼和半瓶水，以及刚用奖励点换到的压缩饼干和棒棒糖。
这点补给可坚持不到三天后。
他在附近的幸存者聚居地，有一个简陋的小窝，里面放着一些补给和用得上的工具。

楚光打算回去收拾一下，能带过来的都慢慢捡过来。
以后这里就是他的新根据地了。
“对了，小柒。”
“怎么了主人？”
“我需要你帮我一个忙。”
顿了顿，楚光继续说道。
“我们的官网太简陋了，我需要你给它，添加一个论坛功能和资料、图鉴功能，能办到吗？”
简单来说，他想让玩家更了解这款“游戏”。
只靠一张嘴就想忽悠人入坑，难度有点儿大，至少表面功夫得做一做。
“当然可以，您有官网的编辑权限，除了游戏预约页面之外，可以额添加子页面或者对已有页面进行更改。”
“很好，那就交给你了。”
“包在我身上！”
对于主人交代给自己的任务，小柒似乎很高兴，连扬声器的音量都提高了半个分贝。
当然，这也可能是楚光自己的误会。
“主人，您什么时候回来呢？”
楚光想了想，说道。
“最晚三天。”
“如果一切顺利，也许明天晚上之前。”
现世，牛马俱乐部群。
那个叫“光”的群老哥，甩完

本来关于“完全沉浸式虚拟现实游戏”的话题都快过去了，结果几分钟前这位老哥拉小群的骚操作，又把大群里的话题给拉了回去。
戒烟：【我勒个去，这家伙是来真的？】
这戒烟也是个常冒泡的活跃群成员，虽然不是管理。
白驹过隙：【嗯，你们点完预约之后，他拉了个小群，把我们几个群管理都拉进去了。（挠头）】
白驹过隙是群主，自然也在那个小群里。
一听这话，群员们瞬间沸腾了。
【靠！黑幕啊！】
【光哥入职的那家公司叫啥你们知不知道？我要举报他PY交易！（滑稽）】
【扯犊子吧，还公司！去年癌股有个做VR的公司，赔的特么老板都被关进去了！现在的风口早就不是VR了！】
【你们小点声讨论，人家阿光指不定在窥屏呢。（滑稽）】
【你说他到底图啥？就为了开个玩笑？】
【鬼晓得，没准是把你们这些亲兄弟引流到菠菜网站，等人多了嘎嘎割韭菜！】
【我看这家伙就不是什么好东西！踢了得了。】
话题渐渐不得劲儿。
甚至上升到人生攻击。
叶炜看着直皱眉，刚想说点什么，便看见群主出来踩刹车了。
（全群禁言）
白驹过隙：【大家别这样，新来的群员可能不认识阿光，他人还是不错的，就是枪法马了点，眼睛瞎了点，人菜了点，其他都还好。】
来日方长：【确实，我相信阿光不是误入歧途搞什么菠菜。我们现在就是不确定，他是不是被盗号了。如果是，这个我们管理组会处理的。一会儿消息我都撤回了，大家换个话题哈。（笑）】
（群禁言解除）

群主和管理都出来放话了，大家也很给面子地不再聊这个话题，很快跑偏到了欧洲杯上。
叶炜不看球，至少不看足球。
看了眼屏幕右下角时间，这会儿已经18：00，正好也到了饭点。
将没做完的大作业上传到云盘，叶炜推开椅子起身，下楼去食堂点了份辣鸡炒饭，美滋滋地吃完。
当他优哉游哉回到寝室的时候，看到桌子上的纸箱子，整个人忽然愣了下。
“阿炜，你买的啥东西？这么大个玩意儿？”
同寝室哥们儿凑了过来，另外俩牲口也将注意力放到了这边。
大家都是有素质的人。
之前叶炜不在寝室，不好动他东西。现在人回来了，也就无所谓了。
他们都很好奇，这家伙买了个啥。
“我没买东西啊……这玩意儿是谁送过来的？”
三个室友相识一眼。
“我没注意……”
“我也没注意。”
“不知道，我刚去拿外卖了。”
邪门儿了！
平时快递都是扔宿舍楼下的快递站，今天倒是送上门了。
更邪门儿的是，叶炜寻思着自己也没在网购地址里写，自己是坐哪个座位的。
现在的快递小哥都这么牛逼的吗？
拆开纸箱子，里面躺着一顶头盔。

这玩意儿的造型和摩托车头盔很像，里外都刷着黑漆，看着其貌不扬。
要说哪里特别，恐怕就是没有前脸，戴上去整个脑袋都能罩住，根本啥也看不见。
乍一看，叶炜还以为这玩意儿是一口锅。
“这啥玩意儿。”
隔壁桌的哥们儿拿起头盔摆弄了下，戴在头上，又摘了下来，一头雾水地还给了叶炜。
“你问我，我问谁。”
难道真是锅？
叶炜也一脸懵逼地试着将它扣在了脑袋上。
视域内一片漆黑。
然而就在他正要将它摘下的时候，一束淡蓝色的光亮忽然透过黑暗，映入他的视网膜。
【等待游戏激活：71小时19分】
难道是那个游戏头盔？！
发货速度这么快的吗？
叶炜整个人都傻了。
“你们都没看见吗？”
把头盔摘了下来，叶炜看向刚才带着头盔的室友。
然而那个室友，同样一脸懵逼地看着他。
“看见什么？”
叶炜急忙道：“那个倒计时啊！上面写着等待游戏激活！”
“啥？这玩意儿还能是游戏机？”

“让开让开，刘哥眼睛不好，我来瞧瞧。”
另一名室友接过头盔戴上，然而过了一会儿，却是和之前那人一样，一头雾水地将头盔摘了下来。
“没有啊。”
“我来。”
这下子三个室友都试了一遍，无一例外啥也没见着。
相视一眼，他们不约而同地看向了叶炜，表情古怪。
“兄弟。”
叶炜：“……咋？”
“要不……你去医院瞧瞧？”
“滚！”
叶炜骂骂咧咧地一把抢过头盔，不信邪地再次戴上。
淡蓝色的小字如期而至。
【等待游戏激活：71小时17分】
倒计时前进了2分钟。
不只如此……
就在这时他忽然发现，不管自己怎么转动头盔，那行倒计时永远出现在自己视域的正中央。
哪怕他把眼睛闭上。
叶炜摘下头盔，一脸见了鬼。
还真见了鬼了！
content_en:
It turned out that I had misunderstood.
There are indeed "five" rewards from the blind box.
The system does not do such immoral things as "swallowing equipment", and there is indeed no such thing as "thank you for your patronage".
However, the prize from the fifth blind box was suppressed by the other four prizes...
What was in front of Chu Guang at this moment was a vacuum-packed compressed biscuit with a net content of 100g, and three lollipops with a net content of 25g - apple, banana, and mango flavors respectively.
And, a note.
The packaging of the compressed biscuits is intact and there are no bulges. Although the shelf life and production date are a mystery, they should not kill anyone.
This thing is a good thing.
There are 500 calories listed on the ingredient list. Whether you eat it dry or cook it into a paste, it can fill your stomach.
As for lollipops, although they are not low in calories, they do not provide a feeling of satiety.
However, for Chu Guang, who was so poor that he was almost chewing tree bark, it was pretty good.
Speaking of which, this system is too stingy. I was worried that he would be too full or something, so I sent him this little thing.
Standing next to the outlet, Chu Guang stuffed the food into his backpack, then picked up the note sent out by the conveyor belt, unfolded it and took a look.
There are some words written on it, using the language of this world.
[...Is there any creature in this world that is more suitable to be a leek than a player?
Not only do they have strong curiosity, but they are also always full of enthusiasm. They face difficulties head on and will not despair of the predicament in front of them. Of course, the most important thing is that they can even consider problems from the perspective of operators and help operators harvest themselves!
I'm a genius at packaging this set into a game!
——The first generation manager of Vault 404; (Please put this note in the fifth primary blind box. This is the Easter egg I leave to my successor!)]
Chu Guang: "..."
To be honest, not only did he not feel the slightest surprise about harvesting Easter eggs, he was even a little speechless.
But...
What does device mean?
"Xiao Qi."
"What's wrong, Master?"
"Do you know the first generation of managers?"
"I don't know. My main program was only activated when you entered the shelter. According to the records in the shelter database, it was more than a century ago that the previous manager handed over the operating authority."
Chu Guang continued to ask.
"What year exactly is it?"
Xiaoqi answered.
"January 1, 2157."
The war ended in 2129, and human civilization entered the Wasteland Era. 2157 is the 28th year of the Wasteland Era.
From now...
183 years!
Chu Guang has been very sensitive to numbers since he was a child, especially this kind of key information. He is basically
"In other words, the first generation of managers 183 years ago invented this device that can project the consciousness of a parallel world onto clones, and packaged it into a game, but for some reason it has never been used, right?"
Maybe it's nuclear winter.
Or there may be other reasons why the shelter does not meet the activation conditions.
No matter how you think about it, people who lived a hundred years ago should be dead.
Xiaoqi said.
"Probably so."
"What's his name? The first-generation manager."
Chu Guang was suddenly curious about his identity.
The person who came up with those wicked settings is not necessarily a genius, but for someone who can single-handedly invent such awesome black technology after the decline of civilization, the word genius is no longer enough to describe him.
Project the consciousness of the parallel world to this plane and put it into the clone body as the container.
Chu Guang couldn't imagine how this was done.
Technology beyond cognition is no different from magic to him.
"I don't know either. There is no detailed information about him in the known databases., could it have been deleted? "
"Forget it...asking you is like asking in vain. "
Chu Guang was slightly disappointed, but not discouraged.
Currently, the shelter has only been unlocked to level B1.
As the mission continues to advance, the secrets buried in this shelter will one day be revealed in full before him.
Chu Guang stuffed the note into the drawer of his computer desk and tightened his backpack.
Noticing his movements, Xiao Qi squatted in the corner and asked.
"Master, are you leaving? "
The sound without any ups and downs sounded pitiful.
"Well, players will log in in three days. There is no point in me continuing to guard here. It is better to go back and prepare. "
This poor place is said to be a shelter, but it doesn't even have food or drink.
Chu Guang only had half a palm-sized piece of cake and half a bottle of water left on him, as well as the compressed biscuits and lollipops he had just exchanged for reward points.
This little supply will last less than three days.
He had a simple den in a nearby survivor settlement, which contained some supplies and useful tools.
Chu Guang planned to go back and clean up, and slowly picked up everything he could bring.
This will be his new base from now on.
"By the way, Xiaoqi. "
"What's wrong, Master? "
"I need you to do me a favor. "
After a pause, Chu Guang continued.
"Our official website is too simple. I need you to add a forum function, information, and illustration function to it. Can you do it? "
Simply put, he wants players to know more about this "game".
It's a bit difficult to trick people into falling into a trap with just one mouthful, but at least you have to do some superficial work.
"Of course you can. You have editing rights on the official website. In addition to the game reservation page, you can add subpages or make changes to existing pages. "
"Very well, I'll leave it to you. "
"Wrap it on me! "
Xiao Qi seemed very happy about the task assigned to her by her master, even raising the volume of the speaker by half a decibel.
Of course, this may also be Chu Guang's own misunderstanding.
"Master, when will you come back? "
Chu Guang thought for a while and said.
“Three days at the latest. "
“Maybe by tomorrow night if all goes well. "
In this world, the cattle and horse club group.
That guy named "Light" is gone
The topic about "fully immersive virtual reality games" was almost over, but a few minutes ago, this old man's flirtatious behavior in the small group brought the topic back in the large group.
Quit smoking: [Let me choke you, is this guy serious? 】
This quit smoking is also an active member of the group that often bubbles up, although it is not the management.
Bai Ju passed by and said: [Well, after you clicked to make a reservation, he created a small group and included all of us group managers. (scratches head)]
Bai Ju Guo Xi is the leader of the group, so naturally he is also in that small group.
Upon hearing this, the group members immediately became excited.
【Damn! Shady! 】
[Do you know the name of the company where Brother Guang joined? I want to report his PY trading! (funny)】
[Just kidding, return the company! Last year, there was a VR company in the cancer stock market. It paid so much that the boss was imprisoned! The current trend is no longer VR! 】
[Please discuss in a lower voice, A Guangzhi might be peeking at the screen. (funny)]
[What do you think he is after? Just for a joke? 】
[Who knows, maybe I’ll divert you brothers to the spinach website, and wait until there are too many people to cut leeks! 】
[I don’t think this guy is a good guy! A good kick. 】
The topic gradually became uninteresting.
Even rising to life attacks.
Ye Wei frowned as he watched. Just as he was about to say something, he saw the group leader come out and hit the brakes.
(Ban the entire group)
A sudden moment passed: [Don't be like this, everyone. The new members may not know A Guang. He is still pretty good, but his marksmanship is a bit poor, his eyesight is a bit blind, and he is a bit weak. Everything else is fine. 】The future is long: [Indeed, I believe Aguang is not going astray and doing some spinach. We are just not sure now whether his account has been hacked. If so, our management team will handle it. I retracted the message after a while, so let’s change the topic. (laughing)]
(Group ban lifted)
The group owner and management all came out to speak out, and everyone was too embarrassed to stop talking about this topic, and quickly diverted to the European Cup.
Ye Wei doesn't watch football, at least not football.
I glanced at the time in the lower right corner of the screen. It was already 18:00, which was exactly the time for dinner.
After uploading the unfinished homework to the cloud disk, Ye Wei pushed away his chair and stood up. He went downstairs to the canteen and ordered spicy chicken fried rice, which he ate with great pleasure.
When he returned to the dormitory leisurely, he suddenly froze when he saw the cardboard box on the table.
"Awei, what did you buy? Such a big thing?"
The guys in the same dormitory came over, and the other two animals also focused their attention here.
Everyone is a quality person.
Ye Wei was not in the dormitory before, so it was difficult to touch his things. Now that people are back, it doesn't matter anymore.
They were all curious about what this guy bought.
"I didn't buy anything...Who sent this thing?"
The three roommates met each other.
"I didn't pay attention..."
"I didn't pay attention either."
"I don't know, I just went to get takeout."
It’s evil!
Usually the express delivery is delivered to the express station downstairs of the dormitory, but today it was delivered to my door.
What's even more weird is that Ye Wei wondered which seat he was sitting in, which he didn't write in his online shopping address.
Are all today’s courier guys so awesome?
Opening the cardboard box, there was a helmet lying inside.
The shape of this thing is very similar to a motorcycle helmet. It is painted black inside and outside, and it looks unattractive.
What's special about it is that it doesn't have a front face. When you put it on, it can cover your entire head and you can't see anything at all.
At first glance, Ye Wei thought this thing was a pot.
"What the hell is this?"
The guy at the next table picked up the helmet, played with it, put it on his head, took it off again, and gave it back to Ye Wei in confusion.
"You ask me, who should I ask?"
Is it really a pot?
Ye Wei also tried to put it on his head with a confused look on his face.
The area of ​​vision was pitch black.
However, just when he was about to take it off, a light blue light suddenly penetrated the darkness and reflected in his retina.
[Waiting for game activation: 71 hours and 19 minutes]
Is it that gaming helmet? !
Is the delivery speed so fast?
Ye Wei was completely stunned.
"Didn't you see it?"
Taking off his helmet, Ye Wei looked at his roommate who was wearing a helmet just now.
However, the roommate also looked at him with a confused expression.
"What did you see?"
Ye Wei hurriedly said: "That countdown! It says waiting for the game to be activated!"
"What? Can this thing be a game console?"
"Get out of the way, Brother Liu has bad eyesight, let me take a look."
Another roommate took the helmet and put it on, but after a while, he took it off like the previous person in confusion.
"No."
"I'll do it."
Now the three roommates all tried it again, and without exception saw nothing.
Looking at each other, they all looked at Ye Wei with strange expressions.
"Brother."
Ye Wei: "...what?"
"How about... you go to the hospital and take a look?"
"Get out!"
Ye Wei cursed and grabbed the helmet, and put it on again without belief.
The small, light blue letters arrived as expected.
[Waiting for game activation: 71 hours and 17 minutes]
The countdown has advanced by 2 minutes.
Not only that...
At this moment, he suddenly discovered that no matter how he turned the helmet, the countdown would always appear in the center of his field of vision.
Even if he closes his eyes.
Ye Wei took off his helmet and looked like he had seen a ghost.
returnWhat a ghost!
